resources.string:
To turn auto rotation on or off, use the notification instead of the system auto rotation setting.


Each time you turn auto rotation on, the direction of the screen will be considered your direction, so when you rotate the device, the screen will rotate to face your direction.


To use auto rotation while lying down: 
1. Ensure screen rotation is locked. 
2. Rotate the device until the screen faces the direction you want. 
3. Turn auto rotation on.
If you want to uninstall this, please use the menu item on this screen to ensure the default screen rotation is not left in the wrong state.
Locking screen rotation is now supported. The user orientation screen has been removed since locking screen rotation lets you do the same thing. See the instructions in the main screen for details.
